source: 641 Information From Eating
target: 641 Notitia Ex Edendo

source: Lugano, who had been observing from the sidelines, was taken aback when Lumian handed the thin aluminum foil to Ludwig and inquired if he wanted to eat it.
target: Lugano, qui ex lateribus spectabat, stupuit, cum Lumian tenuam laminam aluminii Ludovico tradidit atque rogavit num eam edere vellet.

source: Despite Ludwig’s previous display of abnormal eating habits, including drinking a tube of human blood in front of Lugano, revealing all the corresponding information, Lugano still harbored reservations about feeding Ludwig just anything, especially something as unconventional as aluminum foil.
target: Non obstante Ludwig prioribus exhibitionibus morum edendi anomalorum, inter quos etiam bibere tubum sanguinis humani coram Lugano, ostendens omnia informationes pertinentes, Lugano tamen dubitationes retinebat de eo quod Ludwig id quodque ederet, praesertim aliquid tam insoliti quam laminam aluminii.

source: After all, Ludwig was still a child!
target: Postremo, Ludwig adhuc puer erat!

source: In the blink of an eye, Lugano witnessed Ludwig silently accepting the old, thin aluminum foil, stuffing it into his mouth, chewing, and swallowing.
target: In momento, Lugano vidit Ludovicum silentio accipere laminam tenuam vetustae aluminii, eam in os inserere, masticare, atque deglutire.

source: “…” Lugano found himself in a daze.

Once Ludwig finished consuming the aluminum foil, he calmly turned to Lumian and inquired, “Which details do you need–information on the cocoa beans used, the precise quantity, additional ingredients, the origin of the aluminum foil ingredients, the production factories, or the individuals most in contact with it?”
target: Postquam Ludwig laminam aluminii consumpsit, tranquille se vertit ad Lumian et quaesivit: "Quae singularia tibi necessaria sunt – informationes de fabis cocae adhibitis, de quantitate certa, de ingredientibus additis, de origine ingredientium laminæ aluminii, de officinis productionis, an de personis maxime ad eam pertinentibus?"

source: Lumian shook his head slowly.
target: Lumian lente caput concussit.

source: “No need.”
target: “Non opus est.”

source: This information wouldn’t help track down Hisoka.
target: Haec notitia Hisokam detegere non adiuvabat.

source: Hisoka had touched the thin aluminum foil while wearing gloves, leaving behind no corresponding personal details.
target: Hisoka laminam tenuam aluminii attigit, chirothecis gerens, neque ullas notabiles informationes personales reliquit.

source: The patrol team had already confirmed that the chocolate packaging was common in Port Pylos, and there was nothing distinctive about the taste.
target: Manipulus vigiliarum iam confirmaverat quod involucra chocolatae in Portu Pylos communia erant, et nihil de sapore distinctum erat.

source: As Lumian responded, a mix of amusement and surprise washed over him.
target: Dum Lumian respondebat, mixtio laetitiae et stuporis eum pervasit.

source: He can even extract such information from eating?
target: Possitne etiam ex edendo tales informationes extrahere?

source: As expected of a monster capable of recovering just by eating and gradually breaking free from the seal’s constraints!
target: Sicut exspectatum erat ab monstro, qui solum ex edendo se reficere atque paulatim a vinculis sigilli liberari poterat!

source: Ludwig seemed to relish the delicacy.
target: Ludwig videbatur ex hac delicia multum frui.

source: After a few moments, he remarked, “The residual chocolate has a hint of depravity.”
target: Post paucos momenta, dixit: "Relictum chocolatum levem vestigium depravationis habet."

source: Depravity?
target: Depravitas?

source: Could it be that Hisoka had carried it for an extended period, corrupting it?
target: Num Hisoka id per longum tempus tulerit, illud corrumpens?

source: That doesn’t make sense.
target: Id non rationem habet.

source: Unless one was a demigod, Beyonder auras couldn’t reach such a level.
target: Nisi quis semideus esset, aurae Beyonder talem gradum attingere non poterant.

source: The only possibility was that they were on the brink of losing control, deep in a state of depravity.
target: Unica possibilitas erat, eos ad finem imperii amittendi esse, in statu profundi depravationis.

source: However, such a Beyonder’s body would undoubtedly display various abnormal details.
target: Attamen, corpus huiusmodi Beyonder sine dubio varias notas anormales exhiberet.

source: They wouldn’t be able to leave the house; stepping out would lead to discovery and pursuit by law enforcers.
target: Domum relinquere non poterent; exire enim ad deprehensionem et insequentiam ab agentibus legis duceret.

source: Could he rely on the human skin Bram mentioned for disguise?
target: Num in cute humana, quam Bram memoravit, uti posset ad se dissimulandum?

source: Lumian was initially puzzled, but then he asked with anticipation, “A decadent aura from the Devil pathway?”
target: Lumian initio perplexus erat, sed deinde cum expectatione quaesivit: "Aura decadentia ex via Diaboli?"

source: Ludwig licked his lips, savoring the taste of the chocolate residue.
target: Ludwig labiis lambit, saporem residui chocolatae degustans.

source: “Yes, at least a Demon’s.”
target: "Ita, saltem daemonis."

source: “Demon’s?” Lumian was taken aback and couldn’t help but frown.
target: "Daemonis?" Lumian obstupefactus est et non potuit frontem contrahere.

source: Having extensively studied Devilology, he knew that Sequence 4 of the Devil pathway was known as Demon, representing a demigod.
target: Diabologiae diligenter studiosus, sciebat Sequenciam IV viae Diaboli notum esse ut Daemon, repraesentans semideum.

source: If the chocolate slightly tainted with a decadent aura came from a Demon, it clearly didn’t belong to Hisoka.
target: Si chocolatum leviter aura decadentis tinctum a daemon provenisset, manifeste non Hisokae esset.

source: Lumian wasn’t arrogantly dismissing Hisoka’s potential to have advanced to Sequence 4.
target: Lumian non superbiter negabat possibilitatem Hisokae ad Sequenciam IV pervenisse.

source: Instead, the aluminum foil and chocolate marks represented the state four years ago.
target: Immo, signa laminæ aluminii et chocolatae statum quattuor annos abhinc repraesentabant.

source: Hisoka couldn’t have been a Demon back then, unless he had become a Desire Apostle upon transmigration.
target: Hisoka tunc daemon esse non potuisset, nisi post transmigrationem Apostolus Desiderii factus esset.

source: If that were the case, his targets for the serial murders should have been Sequence 6 or 5 Beyonders.
target: Si ita fuisset, metas eius in caedibus seriatim Sequenciae VI vel V Beyonder fuisse debuissent.

source: Although Beyonders at this level were rare in Matani, Devilology didn’t specify that serial murders could only occur in one location.
target: Etsi Beyonder huius gradus in Matani rari erant, Devilologia non specificavit caedes seriatim solum in uno loco evenire posse.

source: “Are you certain?” Lumian looked at Ludwig for confirmation.
target: "Esne certus?" Lumian Ludovicum aspexit ad confirmationem.

source: Ludwig replied earnestly, “A Demon’s decadent aura has a completely different texture from Low- to Mid-Sequence Devils.”
target: Ludwig sincere respondit: "Aura decadentia daemonis texturam penitus diversam habet quam daemonia, quae in Sequencia inferiori ad mediocrem incumbunt."

source: Upon hearing his godson’s response, an image suddenly surfaced in Lumian’s mind.
target: Audito filii adoptivi responso, subitam imaginem in mente Lumiani orsus est.

source: Hisoka standing within the wall of spirituality, engaged in a special ritual to establish a connection with a Demon.
target: Hisoka, intra murum spiritualitatis stans, se implicabat in ritu speciali ad connexionem cum daemone.

source: Throughout this process, a few pieces of chocolate wrapped in thin aluminum foil remained in his pocket.
target: Per hoc processum, paucae particulae chocolatae in tenuī laminā aluminii involutae in sinu eius remanebant.

source: They were slightly tainted by the decadent aura permeating the altar, subtly and silently transforming…
target: Illi leviter tintabantur aura decadentia altare pervadente, subtiliter ac tacite se transformantes…

source: Yes, when I perform a ritual, I don’t remove all my belongings in advance and leave them outside the altar unless there’s a specific mention in the ritual requirements that I should avoid…
target: Ita, cum ritu ago, omnia bona mea non praeauferam neque extra altare relinquam, nisi in requisitis rituum specifica verba occurrant…

source: As a Conspirer, Lumian quickly made a guess and asked Ludwig, “Can you tell which Demon’s decadent aura it belongs to?”
target: Ut conspirator, Lumian celeriter coniecturam fecit et Ludovicum rogavit: "Potesne dicere cui daemonis aura decadentia pertineat?"

source: Lumian’s current idea was that if Hisoka couldn’t be found in the future, he would exhaust his resources and seek the help of the New City of Silver’s Demon-Hunter experts.
target: Sententia Lumiani fuit, si Hisoka in futurum reperiri non posset, opes suas consumptus esse et auxilium peritorum daemonum venatorum Novi Urbis Argenteae quaesiturus esse.

source: He would set up a ritual and summon the Demon who had established a connection with Hisoka.
target: Ritum constitueret et daemonem evocaret, qui cum Hisoka connexionem instituerat.

source: He would have it beaten up before interrogating it for information about Hisoka.
target: Illud verberaret, antequam de Hisoka informationibus interrogaret.

source: Ludwig shook his head.
target: Ludovicus caput quassavit.

source: “I can’t absorb such subtle information yet. All I know is that the decadent aura belongs to a family called Nois.”
target: "Non possum adhuc talem subtilia notitiae absorbere. Omne quod scio est quod aura decadentia familiae nomine Nois pertinet."

source: Nois, one of the three Devil families…
target: Nois, una ex tribus familiis daemonum…

source: The Demon responding to Hisoka’s special ritual is from the Nois family? That’s peculiar.
target: Daemon, qui ad ritu speciali Hisokae respondebat, ex familia Nois erat? Id mirum est.

source: How can a Demon respond to a ritual remotely?
target: Quomodo daemon ad ritum remotis modis respondere potest?

source: It has to be at Sequence 3, or even at the Angel level…
target: Oportet eum esse in Sequencia III, vel etiam ad gradum Angeli…

source: According to Devilology, Serial Killers can summon projections of Abyss Demons because those Devils can use the special properties of the Abyss to respond, not because they have reached the corresponding level.
target: Secundum Devilologiam, caedentes seriatim possunt effigies daemonum Abyssi evocare, quoniam illi daemonia proprietates speciales Abyssi ad respondendum uti possunt, non quia ad gradum correspondantem pervenerint.

source: However, the Nois family is a Devil family active in the real world and hasn’t entered the Abyss…
target: Attamen, familia Nois est familia daemonum in mundo reali activa et in Abyssum non ingressa…

source: Lumian made many connections from the Nois last name.
target: Lumian multas coniunctiones ex cognomine Nois intellexit.

source: He concluded by listing three possibilities:
target: Conclusit enumerare tres possibilitates:

source: Firstly, the Demon responding to the Hisoka ritual was none other than the Nois family’s Angel.
target: Primum, daemon qui ad ritu Hisokae respondebat, nihil aliud erat quam Angelus familiae Nois.

source: Secondly, it had reached Sequence 3 and was located in Port Pylos, near Hisoka.
target: Secundo, ad Sequenciam III pervenit et in Portu Pylos, prope Hisokam, collocatus erat.

source: Thirdly, the Nois family had a close connection to the Abyss. They could borrow the Abyss’s properties to some extent. Even a Demon could respond to prayers from afar.
target: Tertio, familia Nois arctam habebat nexum cum Abyssi. Possent proprietates Abyssi ad aliquem modum adhibere. Etiam daemon ad preces a longinquo respondere posset.

source: Lumian pondered for a moment and asked Ludwig, “Any other information?”
target: Lumian paulisper meditatus est et Ludovicum rogavit: "Alia informationes?"

source: “No,” Ludwig replied, disappointing Lumian.
target: "Non," Ludovicus respondit, Lumianum deprimens.

source: Lumian handed over the remaining piece of aluminum foil.
target: Lumian reliquam partem laminæ aluminii tradidit.

source: “Try this one too.”
target: "Experire hoc quoque."

source: Ludwig didn’t hesitate. Like many children drawn to the sweetness lingering on wrappers, he popped the thin foil stained with chocolate into his mouth and chewed.
target: Ludovicus non dubitavit. Sicut multi pueri dulcedine in involucris residuae allecti, tenuam laminam aluminii, chocolatae tinctam, in os coniecit et masticavit.

source: After a moment, while Lugano snapped back to reality, Ludwig looked at Lumian and remarked, “There’s more to this one.”
target: Post momentum, dum Lugano ad realitatem rediit, Ludovicus Lumian intuens dixit: "Hoc amplius est."

source: “What kind of information?” Lumian knew that Ludwig’s special mention had to be of some value.
target: "Quam notitiam?" Lumian sciebat mentionem specialem Ludovici quandam valorem habere.

source: Ludwig responded with the air of a connoisseur, “This thin aluminum foil rested on a table marked by old blood and a splash of coffee. The blood belonged to a deceased male. The spirituality was initially potent, and the coffee was Fermo blend, unsweetened, distinctly bitter yet fragrant.”
target: Ludovicus, cum ingenio perito, respondit: "Haec tenua lamina aluminii in mensa, quae notata erat sanguine vetusto et stilla café, reposita erat. Sanguis viro defuncto pertinuit. Spiritualitas initio potentissima erat, et café erat mixtura Fermo, non dulcificata, prorsus amara sed fragrantissima."

source: Upon hearing Ludwig’s account, Lumian’s mind painted another vivid scene.
target: Audito Ludovici enuntiato, mens Lumiani aliam scaenam vividam delineavit.

source: A few pieces of chocolate wrapped in thin aluminum foil lay nonchalantly on a table, soaked in old blood and spilled coffee. They seemed to share an intimate connection for an extended period. Then, a hand reached out, snatched them up, and swiftly pocketed them before making a hasty exit.
target: Paucae particulae chocolatae, in tenuī laminā aluminii involutae, in mensa non curantes iacebant, sanguine vetusto et café effuso madentes. Illae videbantur intima relatione per longum tempus cohaerere. Tum manus eis accessit, rapuit et celeriter in saccum coniecut antequam festinanter exiret.

source: Connecting the dots, Lumian strongly suspected that the table had served Hisoka in a dwelling he once occupied.
target: Coniungens indices, Lumian firmiter suspicabatur mensam Hisokae in domo quondam quam occupantem fuisset.

source: “Do you have detailed information on the male deceased?” Lumian probed Ludwig for more insights.
target: "Habesne informationes accuratas de viro defuncto?" Lumian Ludovicum interrogavit ad plura discenda.

source: Ludwig shook his head once more.
target: Ludovicus iterum caput concussit.

source: “No, unless I consume the blood directly.”
target: "Non, nisi sanguinem directe consumam."

source: Directly support the authors on WebNovel!
target: Autoribus in WebNovel directe sustenta!

source: The bloodstains likely belonged to one of the victims, Lumian surmised.
target: Maculae sanguinis verisimiliter ad unum ex victimis pertinentes esse suspicabatur, Lumian coniectans.

source: He pondered whether this information was documented in the case file or elsewhere.
target: Meditatus est num haec notitia in fasciculo causae aut alibi documenta esset.

source: Was Hisoka using “No, unless I consume the blood directly.”
target: Dictebatne Hisoka "Non, nisi sanguinem directe consumam"?

source: The bloodstains likely belonged to one of the victims, Lumian wondered if the table had served as an autopsy platform or perhaps an altar?
target: Maculae sanguinis verisimiliter ad unum ex victimis pertinentes erant; Lumian quaerebat num mensa, ut instrumentum ad autopsiam vel fortasse ut altare, functum esset.

source: Lumian mused inwardly, a tinge of disappointment clouding his thoughts.
target: Lumian intime meditatus est, parva taedio delusus, cogitationes eius obscurans.

source: Nevertheless, he refocused his attention on the Fermo coffee.
target: Attamen, animadvertit iterum in café Fermo.

source: Does this mean that Hisoka has a penchant for coffee, specifically the Fermo blend from the Paz Valley…
target: Num hoc significat Hisokam tenere cafearum delectationem, praesertim mixturam Fermo ex Valli Paz?

source: In the Paz Valley, nestled in the Southern Continent, boasted the renowned Fermo coffee, comparable to Feynapotter’s highlander coffee and the Southern Continent’s own version.
target: In Valle Paz, in Continente Meridionali situs, praeclarum café Fermo effulgebat, comparabile café montano Feynapotter et ipsius Continenti Meridionalis versione.

source: It was a luxury enjoyed mainly by the middle class for extended periods.
target: Hoc erat luxus, qui praecipue a classe media per longum temporis spatium fructus est.

source: In Matani, where both East and West Balam produced high-quality coffee beans, such occurrences were rare.
target: In Matani, ubi et Orientalis et Occidentalis Balam semina café summo qualitate novertere soluerunt, talia casus rari erant.

source: The locals had access to a plethora of excellent coffee beans.
target: Indigeni ad multitudinem eximiorum seminum café accessum habebant.

source: Those unfit for export were sold at affordable prices, favored by both colonists and natives.
target: Ea, quae ad exportationem inidonea erant, pretio parabili vendebantur, a colonis et indigenis favebantur.

source: Lugano, now fully attentive, cautiously added, “I’ve heard that those who frequent Fermo coffee appreciate its bitterness and fragrance. However, those who prefer it without sugar are a rare breed.”
target: Lugano, nunc plenissime attentus, caute addidit: "Audivi eos, qui Café Fermo frequentant, amaritudinem eius et fragrantiam colere. Attamen, qui sine saccharo eam praeferunt, genus exiguum sunt."

source: In essence, Hisoka’s unique taste in coffee is uncommon here…
target: In essentia, singularis gustus Hisokae in café hic singulare est.

source: Lumian smiled at Ludwig and remarked, “Well done. If I apprehend the target in the future, I’ll give him to you.”
target: Lumian Ludiovico subridens dixit: "Bene factum. Si in futuro scopum apprehendo, illud tibi tradam."

source: When the time came, Lumian would likely be a Sequence 5. Moreover, he wouldn’t give Ludwig the Beyonder characteristic. Lumian could ease his grip on the boy.
target: Cum tempus advenisset, Lumian verisimiliter Sequenciae V essem. Praeterea, Ludwig proprietatem Beyonder non acciperet. Lumian tenacitatem in puero laxare posset.

source: Give… The notion sent a chill down Lugano’s spine, a hint that his imagination might have run too wild.
target: Da… Notio glaciem per spinam Lugani infudit, indicium afferens imaginationem nimis profligatam esse.

source: To others, gifting a Beyonder of the Devil’s Pathway might relegate the recipient to a life of servitude or worse, becoming an ingredient. However, with Ludwig…
target: Aliis, donatio Beyonder viae Diaboli recipienti vitam servitutis aut peius, ut pars fieri, destinare posset. Attamen, cum Ludovico…

source: Lugano involuntarily shuddered.
target: Lugano involuntarie tremuit.

source: He didn’t dare to think about it!
target: Non audebat de eo cogitare!

source: Ludwig nodded, his eyes gleaming with anticipation.
target: Ludovicus annuit, oculis spe relucentibus.

source: Lumian turned to Lugano and said, “Don’t you have a good grasp of Dutanese? Check Port Pylos this afternoon and find out which shops sell Fermo coffee. It’s preferable if it’s one that has been operating for four to five years or longer.”
target: Lumian ad Lugano conversus dixit: "Nonne bene Dutanice nosti? Revidere Portum Pylos hac postmeridiana hora et invenire tabernas, quae Café Fermo vendunt. Melius est, si ea per quattuor ad quinque annos aut diutius operetur."

source: “Alright.” Lugano suddenly felt a surge of usefulness.
target: "Recte." Lugano subito sensum utilitatis sensit.

source: In the evening, he returned to Suite 7 at B3 and reported to Lumian, “There are only three shops selling Fermo coffee. One is on Cania Street in Resurrection Square…”
target: Vespere ad Suite 7 in B3 rediit et Lumiano nuntiavit: "Tres tantum sunt tabernae Café Fermo vendentes. Una est in Via Cania in Piazza Resurrectionis…"

source: “You mentioned Cania Street in Resurrection Square?” Lumian interjected.
target: "Meministine Viae Cania in Piazza Resurrectionis?" Lumian interpellavit.

source: “Yes, Unit 21 on that street. It’s called Matani Import and Export Shop,” Lugano confirmed.
target: "Ita, Unitas XXI in illa via. Vocatur Matani Import et Export Shop," Lugano confirmavit.

source: Lumian fell silent.
target: Lumian tacuit.

source: “Isn’t it close to Port Pylos’s patrol team?”
target: "Nonne prope est manipulum vigiliarum Portus Pylos?"

source: In Port Pylos, on the third floor of the building housing the patrol team.
target: In Portu Pylos, in tertio pavimento aedificii, quod manipulum vigiliarum continet.

source: Camus received the bounty and gave a fifth to his two companions.
target: Camus praemium accepit et partem quintam duobus comitibus dedit.

source: He then entered the telegraph room and inquired of the telegraphist, “Do you have a telegram for me?”
target: Deinde in cellam telegraphicam intravit et a telegraphista rogavit: "Habesne mihi telegramma?"

source: He had previously sent a telegram to inquire with certain friends if they had any information on Louis Berry, the adventurer.
target: Prius telegramma miserat, ut quaereret a quibusdam amicis si aliqua notitia de Ludovico Berry, viatore, haberent.

source: Since they were in collaboration, he needed to ascertain the other party’s situation first!
target: Quoniam collaborabant, primum statum alterius partis agnoscere debebat!

source: The female telegraphist, wearing a sweet smile, straightened up and responded, “Yes! From Farim.”
target: Telegraphista femina, dulci risu ornata, se recta sustulit et respondit: "Ita! Ex Farim."
